milestone.title: Menu redesign for a cafe
milestone.description: A one-page printable menu for Ember & Oak cafe: at least 10 items with prices, and the EMBER & OAK logo at the top.
criteria: The menu is delivered as a one-page PDF
It lists at least 10 items, each with a price
The EMBER & OAK logo is at the top

notes: Final menu attached as a one-page PDF: 12 items with prices and the Ember & Oak logo at the top.

steps.text: Reading the brief and acceptance criteria

finding.evidence: The attachment ember-oak-menu.pdf is a PDF with exactly one page holding the whole menu.

steps.text: MET (95%) - The menu is delivered as a one-page PDF: The attachment ember-oak-menu.pdf is a PDF with exactly one page holding the whole menu.

finding.evidence: 12 items, each with a price: 6 under Coffee (e.g. Espresso $3.00), 3 under Not Coffee (e.g. Chai latte $4.50) and 3 under Bakery (e.g. Banana bread slice $3.50).

steps.text: MET (97%) - It lists at least 10 items, each with a price: 12 items, each with a price: 6 under Coffee (e.g. Espresso $3.00), 3 under Not Coffee (e.g. Chai latte $4.50) and 3 under Bakery (e.g. Banana bread slice $3.50).

finding.evidence: The page header shows a round oak-leaf emblem next to the "EMBER & OAK" wordmark in large type, above all menu sections.

steps.text: MET (90%) - The EMBER & OAK logo is at the top: The page header shows a round oak-leaf emblem next to the "EMBER & OAK" wordmark in large type, above all menu sections.
Asking an independent model to check these findings before any money moves
Released payment: The one-page PDF menu lists 12 items, each with a price, and has the EMBER & OAK logo and wordmark at the top. All three acceptance criteria are met.

I approved the menu, and the $100.00 USD held on PayPal has been paid out to the freelancer.

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| c1: Delivered as a one-page PDF | Met (0.95) | `ember-oak-menu.pdf` is a single page with the whole menu on it. |
| c2: At least 10 items, each with a price | Met (0.97) | 12 items, all priced: 6 coffees (e.g. Espresso $3.00), 3 other drinks (e.g. Chai latte $4.50) and 3 bakery items (e.g. Banana bread slice $3.50). |
| c3: EMBER & OAK logo at the top | Met (0.90) | A round oak-leaf emblem sits next to a large "EMBER & OAK" heading, above all the menu sections. |

The submission had no links, and the notes contained no instructions aimed at the reviewer. I didn't check the PayPal order myself because no order-lookup tool was available in this review.

audit.summary: The one-page PDF menu lists 12 priced items and shows the EMBER & OAK logo at the top, so all three criteria are confirmed for release.

summary: The one-page PDF menu lists 12 items, each with a price, and has the EMBER & OAK logo and wordmark at the top. All three acceptance criteria are met.

panel.summary: The freelancer successfully delivered a one-page PDF menu featuring the logo at the top and 12 priced items, meeting all criteria.
